executive_summary: A profile of Dr. Bibha Chowdhuri (1913–1991), a pioneering Indian nuclear physicist. She researched cosmic rays and subatomic particle (pi-meson) tracks at the Bose Institute in Kolkata and University of Manchester under Nobel Laureate Patrick Blackett. Nominated for a Nobel Prize by Erwin Schrödinger and appointed TIFR's first female faculty member by Homi Bhabha, her legacy was permanently honored in 2019 when the IAU named a star 'Bibha'.
